builtBy: research on 2026-10-02 (SCVAL) and 2026-10-03 (BVAL 12 teams, PCAL 7, MCAL 9) and 2026-10-04 (EAL 6 teams, recruiting pages only) and 2026-10-06 (the 53 Southern California teams, recruiting pages only): official school athletics sites, school papers, MaxPreps team, career and JV pages; transformed by a script, reviewed by hand, and spot-checked against the cited source URLs
notes: An overlay on data/rosters.json, joined on team slug + MaxPreps athleteId. It never replaces a MaxPreps value: a field is filled only where MaxPreps has null, and where another source disagrees with MaxPreps the disagreement is recorded under conflicts and MaxPreps stays. The same rules apply to every league; a team with no public source beyond MaxPreps has empty lists.

Every filled value names its source URL, its kind (school-site, school-pdf, news, maxpreps-jv, maxpreps-career, maxpreps-team; maxpreps-career also covers MaxPreps' earlier-season roster pages, such as /field-hockey/25-26/roster/, which give a dated class year the same way, and maxpreps-jv is a JV roster page of either season) and a confidence: high = an official 2026-27 school roster or MaxPreps' own data for the same career; medium = a school-site profile field that is not season-dated, a school-paper statement, or a grade derived from a dated MaxPreps class year plus the years elapsed (derived: true); low = a profile field not tied to the season. For BVAL, PCAL and MCAL, a position that MaxPreps lists only for a PRIOR season (2025-26 roster, same career id) is not filled: positions change between seasons.

Names on a school roster that are not on MaxPreps are not added. JV rosters that school sites publish are out of scope, except that Los Gatos' MaxPreps list is the whole program and the school site says which rows are varsity and which JV. Where sources disagree on a grade MaxPreps leaves blank (a school page against MaxPreps' own earlier-season or career data, or a paper against either), the grade is left blank and every disagreeing source is recorded under the player's conflicts with kept: null; nothing is guessed.
si.com rosters were rejected: names only, and for several teams a different or prior-season list.

profiles[] links a player's own recruiting page (NCSA, SportsRecruits, Hudl), captured 2026-10-02 (SCVAL), 2026-10-03 (BVAL, PCAL, MCAL), 2026-10-04 (EAL) or 2026-10-06 (the Southern California teams). A page is linked only when it names the player and field hockey, and either names the player's school or shows the class year the roster shows plus a California hometown; a stated class year must agree with the roster's grade. NCSA pages answer a bot challenge, so SCVAL and PCAL NCSA profiles were matched on the search result (title, the school in the URL path, class year); for BVAL, MCAL and EAL the page itself was read where it answered. For the Southern California teams every linked page was read (NCSA through a headless browser), and a hometown with no state does not count as California. A Hudl profile counts when its team list includes this school's field hockey team, even if it lists another sport first. Social media, news and profiles for other sports are not linked. Recall is incomplete for every league: see docs/DATA-SOURCES.md.

A team's otherRosters says what other public sources showed for its CURRENT roster, which is what its page may claim when MaxPreps lists no players: none (looked, nothing current), partial (a source lists current players in a form that cannot be joined, with what it lists and a link) or, when absent, not checked.

EAL (2026-10-04): recruiting pages only (profiles[]), swept by the same rule. The school-athletics roster sweep (grade, height, number, position, coaches) has still not been done, so the six EAL entries have no coaches or sources and fill no MaxPreps field.

Southern California (2026-10-06): recruiting pages only (profiles[]), swept by the same rule for the 53 teams (the Sunset, City, North and Metro teams and the five Southern Section independents): 267 pages for 202 players. Each page was re-read by two independent verifiers, one checking it against the rule and one trying to refute it, and kept only when both kept it. The school-athletics roster sweep (grade, height, number, position, coaches) has not been done for them, so their entries have no coaches or sources and fill no MaxPreps field.
